component.name: litellm
component.description: TAPPaaS module litellm: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788).

analysis.detail: Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua, and litellm's redis listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.

Jinja rendering in fsspec's ReferenceFileSystem (Kerchunk reference JSON); fsspec is in the image only for huggingface_hub and polars, nothing in litellm opens a reference:// filesystem, and no request can supply one.
